reader_question: What do I need to do before renting out my property?
demand_source: ahrefs volume/KD via scripts/lib/keyword_data.py; DataForSEO SERP reads reports/mindmap-pass/2026-10-25.serp*.json
decision_gap: Page one for the head term is static PDFs, local-agent posts and agency pages; none filters items by the reader's property type, era, loan/rental type or location, and few print a clean worksheet (SERP sample of 10 results, not a claim about every competitor).
method: calculated + reported: one rule per item in src/lib/checklists.ts drawn from cited agency guidance; scenario counts produced by running those rules

findings.label: reported
findings.text: federal rules and agency recommendations listed in the row prompt's CLOSED FACT LIST

counterexample: A reader whose town differs from the state preset (e.g. a mountain town in a no-freeze-preset state) gets the wrong climate items until they flip the switch; the UI says presets are a starting point.
exclusions: No state-specific legal numbers (deposit caps, deadlines, disclosure forms); no prices.
unknowns: Which items readers actually use; whether customization changes rankings.
would_change: Evidence that a state rule the page flags is federally uniform, or a reader-reported missing item.
selected_medium: interactive tool + server-rendered full list (tool is client-only)

provenance.scopeAndLimits: Counts are rule outputs for example profiles, not user data or product tests.
provenance.publicMethod: workedExample section + 'How the checklist is built' + the full list with Only-if tags
